notes.title: "Subliminal" participates in Weplay Culture Exhibition!
notes.notes:
At the upcoming 2024 Weplay Culture Exhibition, "Subliminal" will offer an advanced preview of its latest game content, unveiling the mysteries of the subliminal space. From November 16th to 17th, You may take a first glimpse of this audio-visual feast at booth B10!

Weplay Culture Exhibition Overview:
Date: November 16-17, 2024
Location: Booth B10, Shanghai World Expo Exhibition Hall H4, Shanghai, China
Title: Subliminal
Highlights: First appearance of brand-new game content

notes.title: Check out our offline debut of "Subliminal" at the "G-Fusion" Beijing event!
notes.notes:
Our latest trailer for "Subliminal" unveiled a dimly lit aquatic world with winding slides, various puzzle elements, a complex children's playground with deep, mysterious passages, and peculiar-looking entities exhibiting bizarre behaviors.

The surrealistic scene design, photorealistic graphics, rich level puzzles, and unique storyline have sparked widespread anticipation since the video's release. On September 21st and 22nd, at the "G-Fusion" Beijing event, "Subliminal" will debut its first offline playable version, offering everyone an exciting sneak peek!
